about: Lock-ups of US IPOs that raised $1B+ (base deal) since 2025-11-18, typed by hand from each final prospectus (424B4) and later filings. A step's date is the FIRST day the shares may be sold (a 'period ending N days after the prospectus' frees them on the next trading day). pct = share of all shares outstanding after the IPO.

companies.name: SpaceX

steps.label: 20% after the Q2 results
steps.trigger: Second full trading day after the Q2 2026 results (Aug 4); Rule 144 affiliates excluded

steps.label: 28% after the Q3 results
steps.trigger: Second full trading day after the Q3 2026 results (Oct 20)

steps.label: 7% release (day 135)
steps.trigger: Day 135 fell on a Saturday

steps.label: 180-day lock-up ends
steps.trigger: All remaining shares of the main group, Dec 8 as printed in the prospectus

steps.label: 20% of the extended group after the Q4 results
steps.trigger: Second full trading day after the Q4 2026 results; the date is not announced yet

steps.label: 20% of the extended group after the Q1 2027 results

steps.trigger: Second full trading day after the Q2 2027 results

companies.note: An extra 10% (about 456M shares) would have unlocked in August if the stock had closed at $175.50 or more for long enough; it didn't, so those shares wait for Dec 8.
